settings.title: Settings & Preferences
settings.subtitle: Configure security timeouts, color themes, UI sizing, and application language
settings.languageHelp: All translations are stored in src/i18n/locales/*.json. Community contributors can easily add new languages.
settings.autoLockHelp: Automatically lock the vault and wipe keys from memory after a period of inactivity.
settings.showFaviconsDesc: Fetch domain icons from the Bitwarden/Vaultwarden icon service for Login items.
settings.customThemeDesc: Download the JSON template based on your current theme, edit the hex colors (#RRGGBB) or pixel sizes, and upload it to install your own custom theme.
settings.themeImportError: Invalid theme JSON file. Please check its format.
settings.closeToTrayLabel: Minimize to System Tray when closing window
settings.closeToTrayDesc: Keep FerriVault running in the OS notification bar when clicking the close button.
settings.launchAtStartupDesc: Automatically register FerriVault to start when you log into your desktop session.
settings.startMinimizedDesc: Hide the main window on launch and keep FerriVault ready in the system tray.
settings.aboutDescription: FerriVault is an open, memory-safe desktop client for Bitwarden and Vaultwarden powered by Tauri v2 and RustCrypto.
